title: Leefstijlen in de provincie Utrecht 1988-1989
contributors: H.B.G. Ganzeboom (research initiator and data collector) (Rijksuniversiteit Utrecht, Vakgroep Sociologie)
descriptions: Lifestyle differentiation in Utrecht province Media participation / food preferences / consumer durables / housing / clothing / table manners / healthy living / holidays / moral values / political priorities / cultural consumption / preferences in arts, literature, music and television / cultural consumption of friends / cultural consumption of parents. Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of birth/ residence/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ characteristics of parental family/household/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ politics/ religion/ consumption of durables/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership
